20:13.text: "And I have chosen you. So listen to that which will be revealed

20:14.text: "Verily! I am Allâh! Lâ ilâha illa Ana
(none has the right to be worshipped but I)
, so worship Me, and perform As-Salât

20:15.text: "Verily, the Hour is coming - and I am almost hiding it from Myself - that every person may be rewarded for that which he strives.

20:16.text: "Therefore, let not the one who believes not therein
(i.e. in the Day of Resurrection, Reckoning, Paradise and Hell.)
divert you therefrom, lest you perish.

20:17.text: "And what is that in your right hand, O Mûsâ

20:18.text: He said: "This is my stick, whereon I lean, and wherewith I beat down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses."

20:20.text: He cast it down, and behold! It was a snake, moving quickly.

20:21.text: Allâh said: "Grasp it and fear not; We shall return it to its former state,

20:22.text: side: it will come forth white
, without any disease as another sign,

20:24.text: (all bounds in disbelief and disobedience, and has behaved as an arrogant and as a tyrant)

20:25.text: said: "O my Lord! Open for me my chest

20:27.text: (i.e. remove the incorrectness from my speech)
[That occurred as a result of a brand of fire which Mûsâ (Moses) put in his mouth when he was an infant]

20:29.text: "And appoint for me a helper from my family,

20:35.text: "Verily You are Ever a Well-Seer of us."

20:36.text: said: "You are granted your request, O Mûsâ

20:37.text: "And indeed We conferred a favour on you another time
